content: ## Metadata_Start ## code: en ## title: Stripe Radar Integration ## slug: stripe-radar-integration ## seoTitle: ## description: ## contentType: Markdown ## Metadata_End If you enabled Stripe Radar features on your Stripe account, the results are automatically mapped to the Transaction records in Salesforce. ## Enable in Salesforce - Navigate to Setup | Custom Settings | `Blackthorn | Payments Triggers` and click the Manage button - Click Edit - Check the `Enable Stripe Radar` checkbox and save ## Set the Transaction Fields on Layouts - Navigate to Transaction layout edit page and add the Radar-related fields to the layouts, which are the following: `Risk Level`, `Risk Score`, `Network Status`, `Seller Message`
